entry.title: Research program updated (18 campaigns)
entry.summary: 18 active campaigns; 15 exact probes on 11 engines.

entry.title: Milestone: Strassen rank-7 <2,2,2> and rank-49 <4,4,4> decompositions checked exactly
entry.summary: Sparse exact expansion over Z matches the matrix multiplication tensor coefficient by coefficient; the deep run adds the rank-343 <8,8,8> Kronecker cube. Scope: Classical upper bound omega <= log2 7; not new

entry.title: Milestone: Sidorenko inequality reproduced for proven patterns C4, C6, K_{3,3} and P4 on all hosts with at most 5 vertices
entry.summary: Exact homomorphism counts, recounted from the opposite bipartition side, compared by integer arithmetic on all 52 host graphs; P4 attains equality on regular hosts. The run also records K_{5,5} minus C_10 on the same hosts (and on all 1,252 hosts up to 7 vertices at deep level, minimum ratio about 1.0248) purely as falsifier data. Scope: Known families on a finite host range; the open-pattern data in the same run is exploratory, unreviewed and not a result

entry.title: Milestone: Exact SIC-POVMs in dimensions 2 and 3
entry.summary: d = 2 tetrahedron overlaps 1/3 exactly; in d = 3 all 108 Weyl-Heisenberg fiducials with entries in {0, +-1, +-w, +-w^2} found in exact Z[w] arithmetic, each Gram matrix recomputed independently. Scope: Classical small dimensions; says nothing about general d

entry.title: Milestone: Rota's basis conjecture verified exhaustively for GF(2)^2, GF(3)^2, GF(5)^2, GF(7)^2 and GF(2)^3
entry.summary: Every choice of bases (first fixed by GL-transitivity) has a certified grid; basis counts match |GL(n,p)|/n!. The deep run adds all 1,753,128 instances over GF(3)^3. Scope: Known small cases (rank <= 3); not new

entry.title: Milestone: Graph reconstruction verified for every graph on 3-6 vertices
entry.summary: Burnside-certified census of 4, 11, 34 and 156 graphs; all decks pairwise distinct under an independent canonical form. Deep run adds all 1,044 graphs on 7 vertices. Scope: Known computational range; not new

entry.title: Milestone: Ramsey lower bounds R(3,4) > 8, R(3,5) > 13, R(4,4) > 17 certified
entry.summary: Circulant and Paley colourings checked by exhaustive subset enumeration; the deep run adds Paley(37), certifying R(5,5) > 37 (the best known lower bound is 43). Scope: Classical lower bounds; not a new bound on R(5,5)

entry.title: Milestone: Ramsey R(3,3)=6 reproduced
entry.summary: C5 witnesses R(3,3)>5; all 32,768 labeled K6 two-colorings fail to avoid both triangles. Scope: Finite toy theorem; not a new bound on R(5,5)

entry.title: Milestone: 1/3-2/3 conjecture verified for every poset with at most 6 elements
entry.summary: All 1, 2, 5, 16, 63, 318 posets (orbit-counting certified against OEIS A001035); each non-chain poset has an exactly counted pair with balance >= 1/3, minimum exactly 1/3. Deep run: all 2,045 posets on 7 elements. Scope: Known computational range; not new

entry.title: Milestone: Projective planes of every prime-power order <= 9 and the Bruck-Ryser table to 50
entry.summary: PG(2,q) incidence axioms verified combinatorially; Bruck-Ryser exclusions recomputed by brute-force sums of two squares; deep run to q = 27 and orders <= 200. Scope: Known constructions and exclusions; order 12 remains open

entry.title: Milestone: Maximum arcs (3-dimensional MDS codes) in PG(2,q) for q = 2, 3, 4, 5, 7
entry.summary: Maximum arc sizes 4, 4, 6, 6, 8 with explicit witnesses and exhaustive exclusion of larger arcs; arcs through a frame recount q-2 conics for odd q. Deep run adds q = 8, 9. Scope: Known (Segre/Bose); not new

entry.title: Milestone: Plane Jacobian conjecture verified on all 59,049 integer maps of degree <= 2 with coefficients in {-1,0,1}
entry.summary: 240 maps have constant nonzero Jacobian (matching brute force); each has an explicit inverse of degree <= 2 checked by composition in both orders, and completeness is re-derived from a separate evaluation-based linear system. The deep run covers all 387,420,489 maps of degree <= 3 (816 with constant Jacobian), every one inverted. Scope: Known (Wang 1980; Moh 1983); not new

entry.title: Milestone: Held-Karp integrality gap certified on all 141 graphic metrics with 3-6 vertices
entry.summary: Every instance carries an exact LP-duality certificate checked against all subtour constraints and a brute-force optimal tour; the maximum ratio is 1 for n <= 6. The deep run covers 994 instances up to n = 7, with maximum gap 16/15. Scope: Known small range; not new

entry.title: Milestone: Hadwiger's conjecture certified on all 208 graphs with at most 6 vertices
entry.summary: Each graph carries a proper t-colouring and a K_t minor model (t = chromatic number); the census is complete by Burnside counting. Deep run: all 1,252 graphs on <= 7 vertices. Scope: Known case (chromatic number <= 6 theorem); not new

entry.title: Milestone: Exact Hadamard matrices for 31 of the 32 orders 4k <= 128, including order 92
entry.summary: Sylvester, Paley I/II, a Williamson quadruple of symmetric circulants of order 23 (order 92, found by meet-in-the-middle on periodic autocorrelations) and Kronecker products; each matrix checked as H H^T = nI. The deep run certifies 87 of the 100 orders up to 400. Scope: Known orders; the remaining engine gap 116 is not an open case

entry.title: Milestone: Goldbach partitions certified for every even n <= 200,000
entry.summary: Least Goldbach prime recorded for all 99,999 even n in [4, 200000], each re-checked by deterministic Miller-Rabin; the deep run extends to 4*10^6 (record least prime 751 at n = 3,807,404). Scope: Finite range only; far inside the published 4*10^18 verification

entry.title: Milestone: Frankl threshold verified for ground sets of size <=4
entry.summary: Enumerates all 2^(2^4)=65,536 families, filters union closure, checks exact frequencies. Scope: Finite exhaustive test only; not a proof for arbitrary finite ground sets

entry.title: Milestone: Erdos-Straus triples certified for every 2 <= n <= 20,000
entry.summary: Explicit (x, y, z) with 4xyz = n(xy + yz + zx) for all 19,999 integers, each re-checked by exact integer arithmetic; the deep run covers n <= 10^6. Scope: Finite range only; known computational verification is far larger

entry.title: Milestone: Caccetta–Häggkvist verified on all digraphs of size at most five
entry.summary: Exhaustive n=5 census: 2^20=1,048,576 labeled graphs partition into 9,608 isomorphism orbits (matching Burnside and OEIS A000273); two independent cycle detectors agree. Known result only. Scope: Every labeled loopless directed graph on 2–5 vertices (known finite cases only), checked modulo relabeling
